title: Synthetic CDISC SDTM Data Generation
summary: A Streamlit-based tool that generates synthetic CDISC SDTM clinical trial data (subject-level and longitudinal domains) using machine learning, handling missingness and column relationships; it runs SDV's CTGANSynthesizer for subject-level data, SingleTableMetadata for schema detection, and evaluate_quality for diagnostics.
needs: README claims PAR sequential model for longitudinal data but no direct sdv.sequential import shown in hits; longitudinal.py not included in evidence.
